notes.title: Update v0.87 Fixed profit bug, grants & UI refine
notes.notes:
We apologize for one last week’s serious bug that cause the mining profit became really low, so we did this quick fix version, v0.86 save files could still works in v0.87, but the mining difficulty may take times back to normal.

Here is the list about this update:
-Instant change the cash numbers while player transfer game language.
-Miner HUD (Mining process bar) now display player’s estimated day profit.
-Now in easy difficulty, player will get some cash each week if “life is too hard”.
-Improve Max ENT of some items.
-Improve Max Cooling of sime items.
-Decrease many item’s price.

-Fix a bug that cause mining profit became really low.


---------------------------------------------------
Hope you guys don’t mind so much about last updates’ hard life, we will try our best to make game better and better!

notes.title: Update v0.86 Item Scrapped, temperature system & mega adjustment.
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Finally we could announce that we almost finished the core systems of “BItcoin Tycoon”. We still need to do a lot of works, but we believe Aug might be the month to Full Release.

Here is the list about this update:
-Item endurance system, item could be scrapped now while run out endurance. Also, temperature, difficulty, power supply and many so on will influence item endurance.
-Temperature system. Equips now count temperature seriously. If the devices still in a high temp environment, it will auto break mining condition. 
-Noise (system) displayed in equips page. It does nothing now but will be important in future updates. 
-The cash amount changes while player transfer game language.
-Many units (such as Temperature unit, coin market remind colors) will change in different languages.
-Refined coin settings. Coin could only be mine after it published (depends on real history)
-Add specific power costed infos in power usage page & equip page.
-Change time unit to “Week”. Monday are regard as the begin of a week depends on “ISO 8601 Data elements and interchange formats”.
-Change the UI logistic of speed adjust bar.
-Now speaker will show their name in bottom left.
-Adjust the selling prices. Scrapped items does not cost money anymore.
-Mining difficulty will updates depends on hash rates and many stuff.
-Adjust the unlock tasks dates of GPU Miner & ASIC Miner. （Adjust to Feb and April）
-Adjust the difficulty of unlock stores.
-New 3d models of GPU Miner & ASIC Miner.
-New PC, GPU Miner & ASIC Miner UI icons.
-More item textures and UI remind icon.
-Top UI refined.
-Fix a bug that while drag a new motherboard into the equip page, other items return back to warehouse page.
-Fix a bug that mouse click will interact miners (3d scene) across opening pages.

---------------------------------------------------
Thanks for your read! We hope you can enjoy the Steam summer sales and in next update, we will rework of the Store page UI, add a update system. Don’t forget to leave feedbacks or recommend this game to your friends!

notes.title: Update v0.80 Electrical System, New Overview Page & Selling System.
notes.notes:
Greetings! We just launched the new big update (v0.80) of Bitcoin Tycoon
IMPORTANT REMIND: OLD SAVE FILES DOESN’T FIT THE NEW VERSION!
and here is a updates list:

-Selling system has been added. (select item in warehouse to sell)
-Electrical System, includes a weekly pay fee and an “Overview” Page to manage power. （for now, you can open the page from top left side UI button）
-Add a remind bar while mouse hold on “Star Mining” Button, shows the conditions of the device, ex: Need Power Supply.
-Add a “Stop Mining” Button.
-Adjust timing bar unit from Day to Week.
-Add new tasks to unlock different stores.
-Add new tasks to unlock new furnitures.
-Add new tasks to unlock virtual currency.
-Adjust time scale of the whole game from 432 to 1000. (real time:ingame time)
-Change the Compose Miner’s mechanical, add a “Miner Size” attribute。
-Add even 6 more foods. (Leave feedbacks like what kind of food you want to eat, we will consider to add them later)

-Fix a bug that player sell coins to cash and quota doesn’t spend normally.
---------------------------------------------------
Thanks for your read! In next updates, we will keep working on task, storytelling part, also intense the “Endurance” property. We hope every player of Bitcoin Tycoon could be patient waiting our updates, and sure we will make this game better step by steps!

notes.title: Update v0.79.1 Foods, Mining Progress UI & Bug fix
notes.notes:
Hey guys, here is a quick update:

-Add 5 new foods. (will appear while you have more cash)
-Refine the Mining Progress Bar UI.
-Add sub hardware’s item type name.

-Fix a bug that Compose Minger could not working.
-Fix a bug that Slot info doesn’t show in item info hub.

---------------------------------------------------
Thanks for players who supported our game, and in next update, we will focus on the electrical system. If you still not sure, you can leave a recommend commit in the future, just don’t leave a feedback as “It is not finished, so I don’t recommend”, that is not the way EA release works. Last but not least, hope everyone could enjoy our game!

notes.title: Update#008 Prepare for Early Access
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone! We just launched our last update before the Early Access Release, and here is the list of updates, again, we really appreciate your waiting and patient!

-Remake of the message system and remind system.
-New tutorials. (we are sorry that English translate are really rough right now due to the limited time)
-Message page UI polish.
-Coin Market UI polish.
-Main Menu UI changes. 
-Add unlock system, now coins and some items need to be unlock first.
-Change the CG while loading.
-Add translates to some sub informations.
-Delete Save / Load button in option page since game is auto save now when you click menu or exit button.
-Add a check system that will check your steam account before playing.
-Fix a sequence problem of bottom UI
-Fix a bug that Building page can not be close.
FIx a bug that brand combo system displayed in Shopping page.
-Fix a bug that only 10 minger could be display in list.

---------------------------------------------------
Thanks for everyone reading this. We are really happy to announce that, finally it is the time to release Bitcoin Tycoon as Early Access. It is almost one year since we start to working on this project, and also this game still has tons and tons of problem need to be fix, but we decide to release game first, again and again, really thanks you guys’ help and advices. 
Last but not least, give feedbacks in Steam community is a great idea, don’t forget recommend this game to your friends, May 1st will be the day to EA release!

notes.title: Update#007 Massive Update about Load&Save System, UI refine and more.
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone! We almost forget when we did last update, but finally, guys, Load and Save system has been finished. Check the list below to see what’s new:

-3D environment remake.
-Save & Load system with multi-plays. [ Tips: Game will save only when you click the ingame “exist” button or “(back to) menu” button ]
-Game tutorial has been removed, since someone will get stuck in new version, that will be add back maybe next update.
-New Texture and New Items. Also we fix most of items’ price, make sure player can get benefits from set new PC & Miners. 
-Remake of the Mining Page, that is actually the version #21.
-Add the Difficulty system, also you can pick your portrait now.
-Add Compose Board.
-Board’s slots system rebalanced.
-Add ETH,ETC, LTC mining pools.
-Rework of the “calculate power” system, renamed as “Hash Rate”
-Add a Remining Box while player want switch mining pool after start Mining.
-Adjust the turning effect on Menu scene. Also remove the LOAD button from the board.
-Add musics to game.
-Fix a bug that Sub-Item not display sometimes.
-Fix a bug that Currency except BTC can’t be sell.
-Fix a bug that Purchase Item will add cash to player.


---------------------------------------------------
Thanks for people who support us on steam community also over 2000 steam players who added this game on wishlist. We appreciate you be patient to wait Bitcoin Tycoon get publish, and we plan to publish the EA release on May 1st.
If you want try this game even before the EA release, you can send a email to “gaopengchen4399@gmail.com”, title as “Request Key” or what. However, due to the large amount of emails I got recently, I will only send keys after game update, which means you may need to wait until next update of Bitcoin Tycoon to get a key, we are really sorry about that and wish your can understand. There also has other ways to get a key, asking on “Weibo (99 game studio 九九游戏工作室)”, or request key on “Indienova (Bitcoin Tycoon)”. 
Last but not least, if you have problem or anything want to share, steam community will be a great place to do so!

notes.title: Update#005 Sub Items, Widely English Supported, Compose Miner & Graphic Mining Board.
notes.notes:
Greeting to anyone still waiting about this game! We just launched our new fresh update to Bitcoin Tycoon - Mining Simulation Game. We supposed to work on 3D scenes remake In last 2.24 weeks, but sincerely, there has too many problems need to be fix before we start to do so:

-Fully Supported with English, and we fixed many description problems, if you still see Chinese buttons, probably these are fake buttons so please don’t mind.
-Sub Items system finally seems to be finished, now Case, Hard Drive, Memory Card and Asset are regard as “Sub-parts”, they could be replace by click name button, also by drag icon from warehouse page.
-Item Attributes, Stability and Dig Efficiency has been remove from all items since it is not longer needed in the new version. We also added New attributes, few kinds of Algorithms efficiency, beauty, Noise and so on. Many of them does not have a serious test yet, so don’t be confuse if anything not works.
-Furniture tag has been added in Warehouse page, we will soon update the 3D scene and furnitures, contains a rough interior design system.
-Started money has been changed to 50,000. We also adjust the price of many items.
-Graphic Mining Board now available in store. Finally player can purchase real Miners instead of PC motherboard. Graphic Mining Board works well with different Algorithm, depends on the board’s attributes. We haven’t really test the calculate function, but that part might be polish soon.
-The instructor NPC has been changed from Boss Wang to Mr. Huang. About their story and what happened with the protagonist, we will soon post short comics and story line in “Weibo” and “Twitter”, don’t forget to follow us!


---------------------------------------------------
Thanks for your read! We hope you can stay interested in our game and In next update, we will keep work on 3D scenes remake. If you really interested in this game and want try this game even before the EA release, you can send a email to “gaopengchen4399@gmail.com”, title as “Request Key” or what, I will reply emails each week. If you like to contribute, it will be a great idea to leave feedbacks in steam community, or post a screenshot about bitcoin tycoon, we appreciate your helps!

notes.title: Update#001 Chinese, New UI system and more.
notes.notes:
Greeting to anyone interested in this game! We are really happy to announcement the first update to Bitcoin Tycoon - Mining Simulation Game. In last two weeks, our team focus on add some features as scheduled:

Chinese Language fully supported, at least for that point.

New UI system, we just changed our 6th version of the UI, new UI system looks more like a Web style, since lots of people complain the UI was too mess up before.

Mining pool system builded in game. That may not means you can start mining Bitcoin now cause we still need to figure out the mining UI problem, but it will be fully add in next update.

New item style. The old items image is actually rendered from 3D models, and recently we feels like maybe the cartoon style will be more powerful. We changed part of the items texture, tell me what you guys feel about that.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31133097/5739abb9067223502a937e5374f910a975a41d0f.png[/img]
Characters portraits. We add 8 main characters’ portraits to this game. And in the future we may consider add animations to portraits. 


---------------------------------------------------
That is pretty much what I can find in this early update, we may keep updates every 2 weeks, and in next update we may focus on finish the new UI system and add bitcoin Mining, thanks so much for your patient to read all of these!
